title: Business Analyst - Government, based in Parramatta/Liverpool/Ashfield
text: Business Analyst - Government, based in Parramatta/Liverpool/Ashfield at Clicks IT Recruitment (Sydney, Parramatta & Western Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). A leading Government Organisation is looking for an experienced Business Analyst. This is a contract that will run up to the end of Dec with possible extension. The role will work around the different offices between Parramatta, Liverpool and Ashfield. Requirements: Must have 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst across multiple industries and companies Solid experience in all aspects of Requirements Management including Non-Functional requirements Evidence of exceptional negotiation and stakeholder management Experience working in project initiation with ability to conceptualise ideas and identify options based on high level business needs Evidence of commitment to continuous learning and best practices. Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills. Evidence of exceptional business case writing skills. Solid understanding of the solution lifecycle development process. Solid understanding of Organisational Change Management Experience in supporting the testing process in particular UAT. Ability to clearly document the current and future business states. Adaptable and flexible to changing priorities with ability to juggle multiple initiatives Demonstrated experience in business impact analysis. Demonstrated experience in data analysis and advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Demonstrated knowledge of BABOK or PRINCE2 RFP/RFQ/Procurement experience. For your chance to start in this exciting contract - Do not delay! Hit apply now. For further detail of this role, including the full job description and requirements, APPLY NOW, attention Freda Kwok or call 02 9200 4404 to discuss by quoting reference FK298336.
